notes: Read SKILL.md in full; it is the only file. PowerShell reference for hardening Windows Server: security baselines via Security Compliance Toolkit/LGPO, password and lockout policy, default account handling, LAPS, LSA/SMB/LLMNR/WDigest/UAC registry hardening, Windows Firewall default-deny with management allow rules, advanced audit and PowerShell logging, Defender and ASR rules, BitLocker, Credential Guard, AppLocker (audit mode first), and a read-only audit script.

Following it can make the agent run privileged state-changing commands: Install-Module -Force from the PowerShell Gallery (SKILL.md:39-41), registry and policy edits, renaming/disabling local accounts (SKILL.md:91-93), firewall profile changes to block inbound (SKILL.md:187-192), disabling NetBIOS on all adapters, enabling BitLocker, and Credential Guard with UEFI lock. Medium because these reconfigure real servers and could lock out remote access if the management subnet is wrong; acceptable because the file is a reference for the user's own hardening task, every change strengthens rather than disables a security control, BitLocker passwords are prompted with Read-Host -AsSecureString, and AppLocker is staged in audit mode. Users should confirm and test changes (especially firewall defaults and Credential Guard UEFI lock) before applying to production.

Privacy note: SKILL.md:352 sets Defender SubmitSamplesConsent SendAllSamples, which uploads files to Microsoft; users with data-residency constraints should choose a narrower setting. SKILL.md:45 'Import-Module ...LGPO.exe' is an incorrect command (LGPO is an executable, not a module). Related Skills links (SKILL.md:609-611: ../cis-benchmarks/, ../../../infrastructure/servers/windows-server/, ../linux-hardening/) are optional pointers that do not ship with this skill. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
